   "source": [
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# CIFAR-10: VGG16 vs ResNet18 vs GoogLeNet\n",
    "# Google Colab Version\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import time\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import torch.nn as nn\n",
    "import torch.optim as optim\n",
    "import torchvision\n",
    "import torchvision.transforms as transforms\n",
    "import torchvision.models as models\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 1. Device Configuration\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "device = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Using device:\", device)\n",
    "\n",
    "if torch.cuda.is_available():\n",
    "    print(\"GPU:\", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(\"⚠️ GPU not enabled. Go to Runtime → Change runtime type → GPU\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 2. Data Preparation\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "transform_train = transforms.Compose([\n",
    "    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),\n",
    "    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),\n",
    "    transforms.ToTensor(),\n",
    "    transforms.Normalize(\n",
    "        (0.485, 0.456, 0.406),\n",
    "        (0.229, 0.224, 0.225)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "transform_test = transforms.Compose([\n",
    "    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),\n",
    "    transforms.ToTensor(),\n",
    "    transforms.Normalize(\n",
    "        (0.485, 0.456, 0.406),\n",
    "        (0.229, 0.224, 0.225)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Download CIFAR-10\n",
    "trainset = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10(\n",
    "    root=\"./data\",\n",
    "    train=True,\n",
    "    download=True,\n",
    "    transform=transform_train\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "testset = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10(\n",
    "    root=\"./data\",\n",
    "    train=False,\n",
    "    download=True,\n",
    "    transform=transform_test\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Data loaders\n",
    "trainloader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(\n",
    "    trainset,\n",
    "    batch_size=64,\n",
    "    shuffle=True,\n",
    "    num_workers=2,\n",
    "    pin_memory=True\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "testloader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(\n",
    "    testset,\n",
    "    batch_size=64,\n",
    "    shuffle=False,\n",
    "    num_workers=2,\n",
    "    pin_memory=True\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Training images:\", len(trainset))\n",
    "print(\"Testing images :\", len(testset))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 3. Create Models\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "def get_model(name, num_classes=10):\n",
    "\n",
    "    if name == \"VGG16\":\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = models.vgg16(\n",
    "            weights=models.VGG16_Weights.DEFAULT\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        model.classifier[6] = nn.Linear(\n",
    "            model.classifier[6].in_features,\n",
    "            num_classes\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif name == \"ResNet18\":\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = models.resnet18(\n",
    "            weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        model.fc = nn.Linear(\n",
    "            model.fc.in_features,\n",
    "            num_classes\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    elif name == \"GoogLeNet\":\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = models.googlenet(\n",
    "            weights=models.GoogLeNet_Weights.DEFAULT,\n",
    "            aux_logits=True\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        model.fc = nn.Linear(\n",
    "            model.fc.in_features,\n",
    "            num_classes\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(\"Unknown model name\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return model.to(device)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 4. Count Trainable Parameters\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "def count_parameters(model):\n",
    "\n",
    "    return sum(\n",
    "        p.numel()\n",
    "        for p in model.parameters()\n",
    "        if p.requires_grad\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 5. Train + Evaluate\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "def train_and_eval(model_name, epochs=1):\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 50)\n",
    "    print(\"Training:\", model_name)\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 50)\n",
    "\n",
    "    model = get_model(model_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
    "\n",
    "    optimizer = optim.Adam(\n",
    "        model.parameters(),\n",
    "        lr=0.0001\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    param_count = count_parameters(model)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\n",
    "        \"Trainable parameters:\",\n",
    "        round(param_count / 1e6, 2),\n",
    "        \"Million\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "    # Training\n",
    "    # --------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "    start_time = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "    model.train()\n",
    "\n",
    "    for epoch in range(epochs):\n",
    "\n",
    "        running_loss = 0.0\n",
    "\n",
    "        for i, (inputs, labels) in enumerate(trainloader):\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Limit batches for faster execution\n",
    "            if i >= 100:\n",
    "                break\n",
    "\n",
    "            inputs = inputs.to(\n",
    "                device,\n",
    "                non_blocking=True\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            labels = labels.to(\n",
    "                device,\n",
    "                non_blocking=True\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
    "\n",
    "            outputs = model(inputs)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # GoogLeNet returns auxiliary outputs during training\n",
    "            if isinstance(outputs, tuple):\n",
    "                main_output, aux1, aux2 = outputs\n",
    "\n",
    "                loss = (\n",
    "                    criterion(main_output, labels)\n",
    "                    + 0.3 * criterion(aux1, labels)\n",
    "                    + 0.3 * criterion(aux2, labels)\n",
    "                )\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                loss = criterion(outputs, labels)\n",
    "\n",
    "            loss.backward()\n",
    "\n",
    "            optimizer.step()\n",
    "\n",
    "            running_loss += loss.item()\n",
    "\n",
    "        print(\n",
    "            f\"Epoch [{epoch+1}/{epochs}] \"\n",
    "            f\"Loss: {running_loss / min(100, len(trainloader)):.4f}\"\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    training_time = time.time() - start_time\n",
    "\n",
    "    # --------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "    # Evaluation\n",
    "    # --------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "    model.eval()\n",
    "\n",
    "    correct = 0\n",
    "    total = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "\n",
    "        for i, (inputs, labels) in enumerate(testloader):\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Evaluate first 30 batches\n",
    "            if i >= 30:\n",
    "                break\n",
    "\n",
    "            inputs = inputs.to(\n",
    "                device,\n",
    "                non_blocking=True\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            labels = labels.to(\n",
    "                device,\n",
    "                non_blocking=True\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            outputs = model(inputs)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # During evaluation GoogLeNet returns only main output\n",
    "            if isinstance(outputs, tuple):\n",
    "                outputs = outputs[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "            _, predicted = torch.max(\n",
    "                outputs.data,\n",
    "                1\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            total += labels.size(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "            correct += (\n",
    "                predicted == labels\n",
    "            ).sum().item()\n",
    "\n",
    "    accuracy = 100 * correct / total\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"Training Time:\", round(training_time, 2), \"seconds\")\n",
    "    print(\"Accuracy:\", round(accuracy, 2), \"%\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    return param_count, training_time, accuracy\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 6. Benchmark Models\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "architectures = [\n",
    "    \"VGG16\",\n",
    "    \"ResNet18\",\n",
    "    \"GoogLeNet\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for arch in architectures:\n",
    "\n",
    "    params, train_time, acc = train_and_eval(\n",
    "        arch,\n",
    "        epochs=1\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    results.append({\n",
    "        \"Model\": arch,\n",
    "        \"Parameters (M)\": round(params / 1e6, 2),\n",
    "        \"Train Time (s)\": round(train_time, 2),\n",
    "        \"Accuracy (%)\": round(acc, 2)\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 7. Summary Table\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 50)\n",
    "print(\"             COMPARATIVE SUMMARY\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 50)\n",
    "\n",
    "display(df)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 8. Plot Results\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(\n",
    "    1,\n",
    "    3,\n",
    "    figsize=(15, 4)\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Model Parameters\n",
    "ax[0].bar(\n",
    "    df[\"Model\"],\n",
    "    df[\"Parameters (M)\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[0].set_title(\n",
    "    \"Model Size (Million Parameters)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[0].set_ylabel(\n",
    "    \"Parameters (M)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Training Time\n",
    "ax[1].bar(\n",
    "    df[\"Model\"],\n",
    "    df[\"Train Time (s)\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[1].set_title(\n",
    "    \"Training Speed\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[1].set_ylabel(\n",
    "    \"Time (Seconds)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Accuracy\n",
    "ax[2].bar(\n",
    "    df[\"Model\"],\n",
    "    df[\"Accuracy (%)\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[2].set_title(\n",
    "    \"Test Accuracy\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[2].set_ylabel(\n",
    "    \"Accuracy (%)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  }
